    Edges

    • edges.list List edges
    • edges.create Create an edge
    • edges.delete Delete an edge

    edges.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges MCP edges_list

    List edges

    Connections on a chart. Ownership edges carry a percent ("" when unspecified); group edges are grouping only.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    chartstringrequiredChart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app.
    nodestringOnly edges touching this node id.
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "chart": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Chart id, or \"active\" for the chart open in the app."
    },
    "node": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Only edges touching this node id."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "chart"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    itemsobject[]required
    items[].idstringrequired
    items[].fromstringrequired
    items[].tostringrequired
    items[].typeenumrequiredOne of ownership, group.
    items[].percentstringrequired
    nextCursorstring | nullrequired
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "from": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "to": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": {
            "enum": [
              "ownership",
              "group"
            ]
          },
          "percent": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "from",
          "to",
          "type",
          "percent"
        ]
      }
    },
    "nextCursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "rev": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Workspace revision after (or at) this call."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "items",
    "nextCursor",
    "rev"
  ]
}

    Example: Edges

    curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
    {
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "o1",
      "from": "cleo",
      "to": "quill",
      "type": "ownership",
      "percent": "50"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}

    edges.create write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges MCP edges_create

    Create an edge

    Connect two cards on the same chart. A second edge between the same pair (same direction) is refused with 409.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    chartstringrequiredChart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app.
    fromstringrequiredNode id.
    tostringrequiredNode id.
    typeenumOne of ownership, group.
    percentstring | number0-100, or "" for unspecified.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "chart": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Chart id, or \"active\" for the chart open in the app."
    },
    "from": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Node id."
    },
    "to": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Node id."
    },
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "ownership",
        "group"
      ],
      "default": "ownership"
    },
    "percent": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "number"
      ],
      "description": "0-100, or \"\" for unspecified."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "chart",
    "from",
    "to"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.
    edgeobjectrequired
    edge.idstringrequired
    edge.fromstringrequired
    edge.tostringrequired
    edge.typeenumrequiredOne of ownership, group.
    edge.percentstringrequired
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "rev": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Workspace revision after (or at) this call."
    },
    "edge": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "from": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "to": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "enum": [
            "ownership",
            "group"
          ]
        },
        "percent": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "from",
        "to",
        "type",
        "percent"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "rev",
    "edge"
  ]
}

    Example: 50% ownership

    curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"from":"cleo","to":"quill","percent":"50"}'
    {
  "rev": 45,
  "edge": {
    "id": "o1",
    "from": "cleo",
    "to": "quill",
    "type": "ownership",
    "percent": "50"
  }
}

    edges.delete write

    DELETE /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges/{edge} MCP edges_delete

    Delete an edge

    Remove one connection. The cards it joined stay. Earlier revisions are kept in the workspace history.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    chartstringrequiredChart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app.
    edgestringrequiredEdge id.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "chart": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Chart id, or \"active\" for the chart open in the app."
    },
    "edge": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Edge id."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "chart",
    "edge"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.
    deletedstringrequired
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "rev": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Workspace revision after (or at) this call."
    },
    "deleted": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "rev",
    "deleted"
  ]
}

    Example: Delete

    curl -sS -X DELETE "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges/o1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
    {
  "rev": 46,
  "deleted": "o1"
}
